description: Backend: migration adding proof_document_path column, proof upload logic in saveResidentCensusUpdate(), getCensusUpdateDiff() endpoint, user-name sync in applyResidentCensusPayload(), and new routes.
steps: 1. Create migration file app/Database/Migrations/2026-10-08-000001_AddProofDocumentToCensusUpdateAuthorizations.php. Use $this->db->fieldExists() to safely add column `proof_document_path VARCHAR(255) NULL` to census_update_authorizations. Implement up() and down().

3. In CensusController::saveResidentCensusUpdate() (around line 1806, just before the CensusUpdateAuthorizationModel()->update() call), insert proof-upload logic: (a) Determine the NAME_FIELDS that require proof: for scope='head' check last_name, first_name, middle_name, suffix, date_of_birth against current $household DB values; for scope='member' check member_last_name->last_name, member_first_name->first_name, member_middle_name->middle_name, member_date_of_birth->date_of_birth against current $own (member row) DB values. (b) If any name/DOB field has changed compared to DB value, require proof: call $proofFile = $this->request->getFile('proof_document'); if (!$proofFile || !$proofFile->isValid() || $proofFile->getError() === UPLOAD_ERR_NO_FILE) return redirect()->to($this->censusPortal('census-update'))->with('error', 'Please upload a valid ID or supporting document to verify your name/personal information change.'); (c) Validate type: $ext = strtolower($proofFile->getExtension() ?: $proofFile->guessExtension()); if ($ext==='jpeg') $ext='jpg'; if (!in_array($ext, ['jpg','png','pdf'], true)) return redirect error 'Only JPG, PNG, or PDF documents are accepted.'; (d) Validate size: if ($proofFile->getSize() > 5*1024*1024) return redirect error 'Proof document must be under 5 MB.'; (e) Save file: $uploadDir = WRITEPATH.'uploads/census_proof/'; if (!is_dir($uploadDir)) @mkdir($uploadDir, 0755, true); $fileName = 'proof_'.$userId.'_'.time().'_'.bin2hex(random_bytes(2)).'.'.$ext; $proofFile->move($uploadDir, $fileName); $proofDocPath = 'uploads/census_proof/'.$fileName; (f) Add proof_document_path to the update array passed to CensusUpdateAuthorizationModel()->update().

4. Add new method CensusController::getCensusUpdateDiff(int $id) returning JSON. Logic: (a) Role check: if (!can_role('secretary','captain','admin','council')) return setJSON(['ok'=>false,'message'=>'Unauthorized'])->setStatusCode(403). (b) Fetch $auth = (new CensusUpdateAuthorizationModel())->find($id); if not found or status not in ['submitted','sent'] return 404 JSON. (c) $payload = json_decode($auth['notes'], true). (d) Build diff array: compare payload fields against current DB values from $this->householdModel (for scope='head') or $this->memberModel (for scope='member'). Use a label map for human-readable field names. For each field in NAME_FIELDS and other payload keys, if old !== new push ['field'=>$field, 'label'=>$label, 'old'=>$oldVal, 'new'=>$newVal] onto $diff. (e) Determine confirm_only flag. (f) Build proof_url: if $auth['proof_document_path'] is set, use base_url('uploads/'.(string)$auth['proof_document_path']) — actually the route /uploads/(:any) requires auth so use base_url().'/'.$auth['proof_document_path']. Return full JSON: {ok:true, diff:$diff, confirm_only:$confirmOnly, proof_url:$proofUrl, resident_name:$name, submitted_at:$auth['submitted_at'], auth_id:$id}.

5. Modify CensusController::applyResidentCensusPayload() to accept a second parameter int $userId = 0. After updating household/member records, if $userId > 0 and payload contains any of last_name/first_name/middle_name, update users table: $userUpdates = []; foreach (['last_name','first_name','middle_name'] as $col) { if (isset($householdFields[$col])) $userUpdates[$col] = $householdFields[$col]; } if ($userUpdates !== []) (new UserModel())->update($userId, $userUpdates);

6. Modify CensusController::approveResidentUpdate(int $id) to pass $auth['user_id'] to applyResidentCensusPayload(): change the call from $this->applyResidentCensusPayload($payload) to $this->applyResidentCensusPayload($payload, (int)($auth['user_id'] ?? 0)).

7. Add routes in app/Config/Routes.php for getCensusUpdateDiff inside EACH of the four role groups: secretary (~line 374), captain (~line 153), admin (~line 541), council (~line 610). Add: $routes->get('resident/census-update-diff/(:num)', 'CensusController::getCensusUpdateDiff/$1'); — place it alongside the existing approve/reject census-update routes in each group.
8. Run php spark migrate from c:\xampp\htdocs\baklod\enu to apply the new migration.
acceptance_criteria: Migration applies without error and census_update_authorizations table gains proof_document_path column.
Submitting a resident census form with name/DOB changes and no proof file returns the error message 'Please upload a valid ID or supporting document to verify your name/personal information change.'
Submitting with a valid proof file saves the file to writable/uploads/census_proof/ and stores the relative path in proof_document_path.
GET /secretary/resident/census-update-diff/1 returns JSON with ok:true and diff array for a submitted update.
On approval, applyResidentCensusPayload also updates the users table name fields when the payload contains name changes.
php -l passes on all modified PHP files.
verification: php c:\xampp\htdocs\baklod\enu\spark migrate — expect 'Migration complete' or 'Everything is up to date'
findings: The census_proof/ upload dir must exist under writable/uploads/ before files can be saved (created automatically by mkdir in saveResidentCensusUpdate). For FEAT-002: the resident census form view (census_update.php) needs enctype=multipart/form-data on the form tag and a proof upload section that shows when name/DOB fields change. The approveResidentUpdate method also calls applyResidentCensusPayload — FEAT-001 has added userId propagation, so FEAT-002 approval UI will work correctly with the existing approve endpoint.
